name: What type of landscape lighting is most energy-efficient?
description: LED landscape lighting is the most energy-efficient choice, consuming less electricity, lasting longer, and offering versatile design options.

mainEntity.name: What type of landscape lighting is most energy-efficient?

acceptedAnswer.text: LED (Light Emitting Diode) landscape lighting is the most energy-efficient option available. LED fixtures consume significantly less electricity than traditional incandescent or halogen bulbs, leading to substantial savings on utility bills over time. They also have a much longer lifespan, reducing maintenance and replacement costs. Furthermore, LED technology offers a wide range of color temperatures and beam spreads, allowing for versatile and sophisticated lighting designs with minimal environmental impact.
acceptedAnswer.description: LED landscape lighting is the most energy-efficient choice, consuming less electricity, lasting longer, and offering versatile design options.
